title: GameStateSample
description: One retrievable game-state sample from a ryleycr1 video: the state as the perception pipeline saw it, what the professional did next, what happened, and (for key moments) why. Stored one JSON object per line in knowledge_base/states/<video_id>-m<match_index>.jsonl.

kind.description: key: within the window of a Phase 1 key moment (carries enrichment); play: state just before one of Ryley's plays; periodic: fixed-interval sample of an ordinary situation

t.description: video seconds of the sampled state

clock.description: m:ss remaining as read from the HUD, null if unreadable

match_seconds.description: seconds elapsed in the match (0-180 regulation, continues in overtime), null if the clock was unreadable

hand.description: card slugs in slots 0-3, null when unread

deck.description: the 8 slugs Ryley is playing (video/game consensus), possibly fewer if unknown

hero_cards.description: deck cards played as their Hero variant when known

recent_plays.description: Ryley's plays in the previous 12 s, newest last

deck_known.description: opponent cards seen so far in this game (in order of first sight)

recent_plays.description: opponent plays in the previous 12 s, newest last

units.description: every tracked unit on the field at t (perception classes, 2024-era detector: newer cards may appear as unknown_unit)

tile.description: [col 0-17 left->right, row 0-31 Ryley's side -> opponent's side]

threats.description: enemy units within ~8 s of one of Ryley's towers, as rendered by the pipeline

action.description: what Ryley did next (within action.window_s of t); 'hold' when he played nothing

zone.description: coarse placement zone on Ryley's side (rows 0-4 back, 5-11 mid, 12-16 bridge, 17+ enemy half)

delay_s.description: seconds between the sampled state and the play

following_plays.description: Ryley's further plays within the outcome horizon, newest last

horizon_s.description: seconds after t over which the deltas below are measured (default 15)

own_tower_hp_delta.description: king/left/right HP change for Ryley's towers over the horizon (negative = damage taken)

threats_after.description: threats still listed at the end of the horizon

elixir_trade.description: opponent elixir spent minus Ryley's elixir spent inside the horizon (positive = Ryley gained)

verdict.description: heuristic: tower HP swing and elixir trade; enrichment may override

game_result.description: final result of this game from the Phase 1 match file

commentary.description: auto-transcript lines within ±8 s of t

key_moment.description: present only for kind=key: the Phase 1 key moment this sample belongs to

text.description: the key-moment bullet from the match file, verbatim

enrichment.description: written by the Opus enrichment agent. Required fields for kind=key; for play/periodic only situation_read and reaction are expected

situation_read.description: 1-2 sentences: what matters in this state (threats, elixir, cycle position), grounded in the state fields

reaction.description: 1-2 sentences: the reaction an agent should take here, in the card vocabulary of the knowledge base

pro_action_rationale.description: key only: why Ryley did what he did, citing his words when he gave them

principle.description: key only: the transferable rule (one sentence)

alternatives.description: key only: other reasonable responses and why they are worse/better

outcome_note.description: how it went, from outcome fields and commentary

tags.description: short retrieval tags: e.g. defend-bridge-push, counter-push, spell-cycle, punish, elixir-lead, overtime

state_text.description: deterministic, compact natural-language rendering of state+action for embedding; produced by the extractor, never edited by hand

cards.description: knowledge_base/cards/<slug>.md for hand, action and on-field cards
